name: Soyuz MS-03
about: Soyuz MS-03 (2016-070A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2016 Nov 17. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2016 Nov 19), held fixed
docked to A07725; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
